title: Microsoft 365 Backup: what is protected, for how long, and what it costs
summary: The documented backup behavior, prices, recovery windows and automation are supported by Microsoft Learn. Minor corrections should complete several control instructions and avoid treating the general billing-disconnection wording as a guarantee that retained Entra backups stop accruing charges.

claims.where: Risks and limits: A budget is not a cap; controls[2].note; What to check

claims.where: Risks and limits: A budget is not a cap
claims.claim: The only way to stop billing is to disconnect the payment method.

claims.fix: Remove '; the only way to stop billing is to disconnect the payment method'. The general commerce page states this, but https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/backup/backup-offboarding says existing Entra Premium backups continue to be billed until they expire. Keep the supported sentence 'Reaching 100% of a pay-as-you-go budget does not stop the service or billing.'
